description:
Compliance Manager

Location- Remote (EST or CST ONLY)

About Us

Clasp is a mission-driven, venture-backed startup transforming access to education and career pathways. A college education was always meant to lead to economic mobility. But with rising costs and shrinking loan availability, many working-class and first-generation students don’t have the money they need to finish school. That’s where Clasp comes in. We’re the market leader in institutionally funded gap loan programs. We partner with schools to design, launch and manage lending programs that keep students enrolled, graduating, and thriving.

Fresh off our Series B, Clasp is entering its next phase of growth. Recent recognition includes:

  • TIME’s Best Inventions of 2026 (Loan-Linked Hiring)

  • Forbes Fintech 50

  • Business Insider: Top 14 Healthcare Startups to Watch in 2026 and 43 Startups to Bet Your Career On in 2025

Interested in learning more? Please find additional details on our About Us page and in recent Forbes coverage of our Series B.

 
 

What We Need

We are seeking a Compliance Manager to advise our Clasp Student Finance business. The Compliance Manager will provide guidance to teams on the application of compliance requirements, balancing commercial urgency with compliance guardrails. In this role, you will work directly with our CCO to support new products and programs and business changes. You will also lead and get involved with other areas of Clasp’s Compliance Management System, including complaint management and corrective action/issue management.


What You’ll Do

  • Manage compliance and risk for our Clasp Student Finance business.

  • Lead Compliance reviews for new products and partner programs, helping to identify issues and risk mitigant solutions.

  • Advise on change initiatives, embedding early to prevent late-stage compliance blockers.

  • Review marketing materials, ensuring campaigns meet UDAAP and consumer protection standards.

  • Run and enhance the complaint management program, including through use of AI solutions.

  • Actively engage in the corrective action/issue management program, managing issues through the process to ensure corrective action and customer remediation.

  • Work with the compliance team and bank partner.

  • Provide support for regulatory, bank partner and other external audits and examinations.

  • Leverage AI tools to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of compliance workflows across advisory, complaint management, and corrective action/issue management.

  • Provide general problem-solving and risk management guidance across the business.

  • Develop in-depth knowledge of products, processes and strategies.

  • Build strong relationships and lines of communication with various business units and external partners.


What You’ll Need

  • Commercial mindset with ability to frame risk as tradeoffs, not just red/yellow/green.

  • Scrappy, resourceful builder who thrives in ambiguity.

  • Strong attention to detail with clean documentation and audit trails.

  • Technical acumen and comfortable working with data.

  • Legal/compliance awareness: issue spotting across agreements, marketing, origination, servicing, and collections; knows when to escalate.

  • Clear communicator who can provide non‑jargon guidance to peers and Leadership.

  • Mature, culturally aligned, and able to operate with minimal oversight.

  • Self-confidence, good judgment, the ability to make sound decisions.

  • Strong understanding of consumer lending laws and regulations (TILA, ECOA, UDAAP, FCRA, FDCPA, SCRA/MLA). Experience operating in the Compliance department of a consumer financial services institution, especially a bank or fintech of a bank partner.

 
 

What We Give In Return

  • Competitive cash and equity compensation.

  • Health benefits (medical, dental, & vision), 401k.

  • Commuter benefits.

  • Flexible PTO policy.

  • Opportunities to grow and perform in a fast-paced environment alongside a stellar team.

 

Salary

The salary range for this position is competitive and will be commensurate with the candidate's experience, qualifications, and industry knowledge, ranging from $130,000 to $140,000 annually. In addition to the base salary, we offer an attractive equity component as part of our compensation package, providing an opportunity for eligible employees to share in the success and growth of our company. We are committed to offering competitive compensation and benefits packages to attract and retain top talent.

 

If you are a scrappy, resourceful compliance professional who thrives in dynamic environments, we want to hear from you! Apply now to be a part of our growing team!

We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where all employees feel valued, respected, and empowered to contribute their unique perspectives and talents. Clasp is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We embrace diversity and are dedicated to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
